versions.content: If a gatewayed TP PDU reception is indicated via PduR_<SrcLoTp>StartOfReception and the total SDU size reported by the pa- rameter TpSduLength is larger than the configured PduRPduMaxLength of the ded- icated buffer, the PduR shall dynamically allocate a buffer from the PduRTxBuffer .

When an I-PDU needs to get buffered, and the required size is larger than the configured PduRPduMaxLength of all free dedicated buffers ( PduR- Buffer referenced by PduRDestBufferRef ), the PduR shall dynamically allocate a suitably sized global buffer ( PduRBuffer not referenced by any PduRDestBuffer- Ref s) with respect of PduRQueueDepth .
